gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, 97887 MiB, single GPU (sm_120 / cc 12.0, 188 SMs)
metric_convention: SERVED TTFT: admission -> first CONTENT SSE frame over the OpenAI /v1/chat/completions endpoint (tokenize + decomposed prefill-bucket chain + first decode token + mux/SSE hop). SERVED TPOT: mean SSE frame gap, first 16 steps discarded, finish frame excluded. Single user, greedy, batch 1 (the 26B MoE decode blob is B=1: flat expert kernels index one token row). Directly comparable to perf-data/gemma4-26b-a4b-vllm-sm120.json (bf16).
run_mode: plowrt serve --assets /root/gpu-assets-26b/b1 --slo-ms 100000000 (features cuda,hf-tokenizer, commit a058492); pkt PLOW_UNISEG=1 PLOW_NS_FULL_ABS=48 gemma4 <26B> 132096 out.pkt 188 (committed P9 recipe; md5-identical re-emitted at HEAD); cubins rebuilt at HEAD with the P9 GF4 recipe (script flags + -DPLOW_NV_FA_GF_FULL=4): decode 219 regs, prefill _pf 240 regs, smem embedded (PLOW_NV_EMBED_SMEM). Engine load: 47.0 GiB weights + 5.6 GiB KV, 21.0 s warm. The serve engine resolves the fused 3-D expert tables by name (moe.ewt.{l}/moe.est.{l}, exec/gpu.rs port of orch::moe::build_fused_expert_table) — no sidecar needed.

campaigns.notes: First measured served 26B rows (P9 bring-up smoke had word-approx ctx only). Gates: 'capital of France' -> 'The capital of France is **Paris**.', finish stop; served greedy == standalone build-gf4 harness PLOW_PREFILL=1 on the same pkt+ids 48/48 (two-phase capture-replay parity, see 31B). TPOT@4k 8.48 ms vs vLLM 7.90 = +7.4%; TPOT@32k 9.22 vs vLLM 9.57 = plow WINS -3.6% (matches the P9/T9 raw ladder: 26B wins 16k-128k). Raw prefill same-lease (cover-policy): 4137=451 ms, 32837=2626 ms -> served 32k TTFT +3.6% over raw (includes 32.8k-token tokenize). Server run with --slo-ms 1e8 (admission-shed workaround, see 12B S6-refresh notes).
